title: Testing an Algorithm for Assessing the Efficiency and Effectiveness of Bridge Life-Cycle Management: The Alarchin Bridge Case Study
authors: V. K. Andreev, E. N. Kornylev
original_title: Апробация алгоритма оценки эффективности и результативности управления жизненным циклом мостового сооружения на примере Аларчина моста
abstract: The assessment algorithm is tested using inspection data for Alarchin Bridge in Saint Petersburg. Five groups of operational indicators are combined into a weighted index. The resulting index of 0.28 indicates low lifecycle-management performance, consistent with the inspection report's findings and the need for urgent rehabilitation.

title: An Algorithm for Assessing the Efficiency and Effectiveness of a Life-Cycle Management System for Bridge Structures
authors: V. K. Andreev, E. N. Kornylev
original_title: Алгоритм оценки эффективности и результативности системы управления жизненным циклом объекта по профилю мостовых сооружений
abstract: The paper adapts a lifecycle-management assessment algorithm to bridge operation. Weighted, normalised indicators cover traffic safety, deck condition, structural condition, inspections and monitoring, and heritage requirements. The method defines thresholds and targets over a ten-year evaluation horizon to support maintenance and repair decisions.

title: An Algorithm for Assessing the Efficiency and Effectiveness of a Life-Cycle Management System for Civil and Industrial Facilities
venue: Modern Construction Materials and Technologies: Proceedings of the 9th International Scientific and Practical Conference, 21 May 2026
original_title: Алгоритм оценки эффективности и результативности системы управления жизненным циклом объектов гражданского и промышленного назначения
abstract: The paper develops an integral assessment approach for life-cycle management systems at the operation stage. It uses normalized indicators and weighted aggregation to compare the current and target state of civil and industrial facilities, with separate priorities for industrial processes and equipment reliability and for the safety, accessibility and service quality of civil facilities.

title: Digital Twin Technology: Economic Advantages
venue: Voprosy Studencheskoy Nauki (Issues of Student Science), 1(113) (2026), pp. 481–488
abstract: The paper reviews digital twins in civil infrastructure, including bridges, buildings and smart cities. It considers sensor-based monitoring, early defect detection, repair optimisation and the costs of implementation, from data collection and instrumentation to digital platforms and staff training.

title: Digitalization of Capital Construction in Russia: Life-Cycle Management, Standards and Vulnerabilities
venue: Voprosy Studencheskoy Nauki (Issues of Student Science), 1(113) (2026), pp. 496–502
original_title: Цифровизация капитального строительства в России: управление жизненным циклом, стандарты и уязвимые места
abstract: The paper examines lifecycle management in capital construction in Russia and abroad, focusing on regulatory requirements for information modelling and data handover. Case studies include integrated building management at Lakhta Center and remote monitoring and inspection of wind turbines.

title: An Algorithm for Assessing the Efficiency and Effectiveness of a Facility Life-Cycle Management System
authors: V. K. Andreev, A. N. Nikulin
venue: High Technologies and Innovations (XXVI Scientific Readings): Proceedings of the International Scientific and Practical Conference, Belgorod, 25 November 2025, pp. 343–349
original_title: Алгоритм оценки эффективности и результативности системы управления жизненным циклом объекта
abstract: The paper proposes an integral index for assessing a facility life-cycle management system at the operation stage. Nine indicators are grouped into three blocks—Product, Production and Equipment, and Planned Modernization—then normalized to a 0–1 scale and weighted. The method compares current and target states over an approximately ten-year horizon to support management decisions.

title: An Algorithm for Assessing the Effectiveness and Performance of the Life-Cycle Management System for Civil and Industrial Facilities
authors: V. K. Andreev, R. V. Motylev
venue: VladStroyTech 2026 · II International Conference of Young Scientists, Vladimir, 23–25 September 2026
original_title: Алгоритм оценки эффективности и результативности системы управления жизненным циклом объектов гражданского и промышленного назначения
abstract: The abstract refines an algorithm for assessing life-cycle management systems at the operation stage for civil and industrial facilities. It uses a weighted integral index built from normalized indicators and distinguishes industrial priorities—process stability, utility-system reliability, downtime risk and economic manageability—from civil priorities such as user safety, accessibility, indoor environmental quality, building-envelope condition and maintenance planning.
